description: Reviewed former county and county-equivalent names/FIPS mapped to current canonical county equivalents for discovery only. One former geography can resolve to multiple current geographies; these records are not vote-allocation crosswalks.

records.caveat: The Census Bureau renamed and recoded Wade Hampton Census Area as Kusilvak Census Area. This discovery alias does not alter reported election geography.
The Census Bureau records Shannon County as renamed and recoded to Oglala Lakota County.
Valdez-Cordova Census Area split into Chugach and Copper River Census Areas. Both successors are shown for discovery; no historical election total is allocated between them.
Bedford changed from an independent city/county equivalent to a town within Bedford County. This is a discovery relationship, not a historical result reallocation.
Petersburg Census Area became Petersburg Borough while retaining FIPS 02195 and changing boundaries.
Wrangell-Petersburg Census Area was reconstituted as Petersburg Census Area and Wrangell City and Borough. Successors are discovery links only.

records.formerName: Prince of Wales-Outer Ketchikan Census Area
records.caveat: The former census area was divided among Ketchikan Gateway Borough, Prince of Wales-Hyder Census Area, and Wrangell City and Borough. Successors are discovery links only.
Skagway-Hoonah-Angoon Census Area split into Hoonah-Angoon Census Area and Skagway Municipality. Successors are discovery links only.
Former Fairfield County overlaps Greater Bridgeport, Naugatuck Valley, and Western Connecticut Planning Regions. Results are not transferred by this search relationship.
Former Hartford County overlaps Capitol, Naugatuck Valley, and Northwest Hills Planning Regions. Results are not transferred by this search relationship.
Former Litchfield County overlaps Naugatuck Valley, Northwest Hills, and Western Connecticut Planning Regions. Results are not transferred by this search relationship.
Former Middlesex County maps to Lower Connecticut River Valley Planning Region in the Census county-to-county-subdivision crosswalk.
Former New Haven County overlaps Naugatuck Valley and South Central Connecticut Planning Regions. Results are not transferred by this search relationship.
Former New London County overlaps Lower Connecticut River Valley, Northeastern Connecticut, and Southeastern Connecticut Planning Regions. Results are not transferred by this search relationship.
Former Tolland County overlaps Capitol and Northeastern Connecticut Planning Regions. Results are not transferred by this search relationship.
Former Windham County overlaps Northeastern Connecticut and Southeastern Connecticut Planning Regions. Results are not transferred by this search relationship.
